GPU_scope: Recorded forward-window maxima only; excludes model loading and between-forward hybrid/control construction and serialization. Not full-collector peak.
timing_scope: CUDA-synchronized forward wall time includes host work within each forward. Collector timers include loading/collection/replay after preflight hashing. UTC command windows include preflight until receipt. These are not GPU kernel profiler times.
scientific_scope: Separate cohort outcomes are not pooled; repeated conditions/technical questions are not independent sampling replicates. No outcomes are aggregated in this cost index.
